_comment: Example config for scripts/ops/Test-StratusphereReadiness.ps1 -ConfigPath. Copy it (for example to parameters/preflight.local.json, which is git-ignored), edit, then run. Explicit parameters win. Remove keys you don't use; their checks report SKIP or use the defaults.
_database: Add "Database" to Role above 1,000 Connector ID Keys, with DatabasePlan.
_collector: Add "Collector" to Role for Collectors, with CollectorPlan and CollectorCount.
_avdCurrentState: Optional: a package from github.com/nickprignano/avd-current-state (folder or zip).
